dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of several irregular, thin-edged elliptical and C-shaped high-contrast perimeters. The most prominent is a closed 'O' shape in the upper-central region with a soft gradient transition from light boundary to darker interior. An adjacent 'C' shape to the left exhibits similar edge geometry with fragmented segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of localized, high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients located in the anterior-lateral and posterior regions. These clusters show a high spatial density compared to the more diffuse central dorsal area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Invariant spatial relationship defined by a scalene triangle formed by the centroids of the prominent dorsal 'O' annulus, the lateral 'C' annulus, and a dense cluster of high-intensity blobs on the anterior-lateral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A dendritic network of low-thickness, high-intensity filaments interconnecting several isolated blobs in the anterior-dorsal quadrant, creating a web-like topology.
